project: Heart Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
target_definition: binary (0 = No Heart Disease, 1 = Heart Disease Present)
primary_selection_metric: Multi-criteria (CV ROC-AUC, CV Recall, Test Recall, Test F1, Low FN)
selection_reason: Tuned Random Forest achieved the highest Test Accuracy (0.9016), highest Test Recall (0.9643), highest Test F1 (0.9000), lowest False-Negative count (FN=1 out of 28 positive disease cases), strong CV ROC-AUC (0.9041), and highest CV Recall (0.8008) among all tuned models.
